geography.basis: The two retained county records describe one tornado but disagree at their boundary coordinates. No connecting route, camera or geographic replay is admitted.

damage.basis: The original county narratives describe damage to oil tanks and trees, homes south of Greensburg and the town. These are reported outcomes without mapped survey points, assigned impact times or a recovered wind field.

appearance.basis: The linked recovery gallery has no inspected storm-time appearance or calibrated viewpoint. Damage dimensions and EF ratings do not supply visible funnel geometry.

gaps.basis: County boundary coordinates, retrospective warning labels, casualty scopes and dated recovery quantities retain their separate source meanings. No clock or location conflict is silently repaired.
